thread:
rita.design: Uploaded a compact Alerting preview focusing on row density and microcopy for suppression. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique (frame: compact-density-v1)

dan.pm: Looking clean. Two quick questions: 1) Do we show suppression inline or via a hover panel? 2) How do we announce preview opens to screen readers?

rita.design: Proposal: show a minimal inline pill on narrow widths, otherwise a hover panel with short explanatory copy. Keyboard should trigger the panel with Enter/Space.

leo.eng: Technically fine. We'll render the panel in a portal to avoid clipping and use a `data-open` attribute on the opener. Use roving tabindex so keyboard users can arrow through rows.

samira.a11y: For assistive tech: announce after panel is mounted. Pattern: mount panel, then update a polite live region after ~50-80ms to avoid empty announcements during animations. Example snippet for devs: 

```
// after panel mount
requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(() => {
  liveRegion.textContent = `Preview opened for ${channelName}. Suppression ${state}`;
}, 60));
```

priya.product: Copy thought: ops prefer "Quiet window" but some users say "Snooze" is clearer. Let's include both in the usability run. Also add short tooltip: "Quiet window — mute notifications for a duration."

rita.design: I'll add both variants to the research frames and include tooltip copy. Also flagged badge contrast: current tokens fail AA at 12px.

samira.a11y: Swap badge tokens to BG #EEF2FF and FG #374151. Make focus ring 3px for compact rows to meet 3:1. Ensure outlines follow system high-contrast settings.

leo.eng: We'll implement token swap and ensure focus ring uses a token so design can tweak without code changes. Also: optimistic toggle + undo snackbar is preferred over confirm dialogs.

dan.pm: Agreed. UX: immediate state change + "Channel silenced — Undo" toast (6s). Keep analytics events: preview_open, suppression_toggle, suppression_undo.

samira.a11y: Snackbars must use role="status" and include keyboard-focusable Undo. Add SR test steps for toggle -> undo -> API-fail revert.

a11y-bot: Reminder: add data-testid attributes to preview opener and suppression toggle for automated accessibility smoke tests.

rita.design: Thanks all. I'll push updated frames, a dev checklist with aria-live timing snippet, portal note, token names, and two copy variants by EOD."
